title: Marlowe & Finch Home Delivery Service Guarantee Schedule: Late Arrival Credit and Missed-Date Fee Refund
content:
Marlowe & Finch Home Delivery sets, for each service level, the service credit given when the team arrives late, the number of minutes after the end of the arrival window beyond which an arrival is late, and whether the delivery fee is refunded in full when Marlowe & Finch misses the scheduled date.

## Schedule

| Service level | Late arrival credit | Minutes after the window ends beyond which an arrival is late | Delivery fee refunded in full when Marlowe & Finch misses the scheduled date |
|---|---|---|---|
| Curbside Delivery | Not applicable | 60 | Yes |
| Threshold Delivery | $25.00 | 60 | Yes |
| Room of Choice Delivery | $25.00 | 60 | Yes |
| White Glove Delivery | $50.00 | 60 | Yes |
| White Glove Delivery with Assembly | $50.00 | 60 | Yes |
| Premier White Glove with Haul-Away | $75.00 | 60 | Yes |

## Notes to the schedule

- The late arrival credit is in US dollars to the cent. Curbside Delivery has no late arrival credit amount; its entry is not applicable.
- The lateness measure is the same at every level: an arrival is late when it is more than 60 minutes after the end of the arrival window.
- The full refund of the delivery fee when Marlowe & Finch misses the scheduled date applies at all six levels.

## Lateness against the 60-minute measure (hypothetical arrival window ending at 14:00)

| Team arrival | Minutes after window end | More than 60 minutes after? |
|---|---|---|
| 14:45 | 45 | No |
| 15:00 | 60 | No: exactly 60 is not more than 60 |
| 15:01 | 61 | Yes |
| 16:30 | 150 | Yes |
